Question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
text:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_multiple_orders
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1
);
```
Counts the distinct customers who have placed more than one order.
reasoning: We need to count customers with more than one order. Use orders table: orders(customer_id). Group by customer_id having count(order_id) > 1. Then count distinct such customers. So SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1); Explanation: counts customers with more than one order.
